name: apple-mlx-foundations
description: Architectural knowledge graph of the Apple MLX Foundations repo: Shap-E and TripoSR ports onto Apple Silicon, plus the optional Swift facade.

nodes.name: apple-mlx-foundations
nodes.summary: MLX-native workspace that ports OpenAI Shap-E (text or image to mesh) and TripoSR (image to 3D) onto Apple Silicon, with a Swift path aimed at visionOS.

nodes.name: Shap-E
nodes.summary: Latent diffusion model. A 300M transformer denoises a latent, a projector turns that latent into NeRSTF weights, and an STF renderer plus marching cubes emits a colored mesh. Text and image conditioning both exist in Swift. The Python MLX runtime surface is text-only.

nodes.name: TripoSR
nodes.summary: Feedforward image-to-3D model. DINOv2 tokens cross-attend into a triplane, a small NeRF MLP queries density and color. The Swift package stops at that query. Mesh extraction for TripoSR lives in RuntimeWrapper and reuses Shap-E marching cubes.

nodes.name: RuntimeWrapper
nodes.summary: Optional model-selection facade. Applications that need one model import that package directly. The two model packages do not depend on each other.

nodes.name: openai/shap-e
nodes.summary: PyTorch reference. Installed from git. Checkpoints land in shap_e_model_cache. L0 parity compares against this, not against Swift.

nodes.name: openai/CLIP
nodes.summary: ViT-L/14 text and vision towers. Shap-E conditions the diffusion transformer on CLIP embeddings. BPE vocab is a separate file the Swift tokenizer loads.

nodes.name: stabilityai/TripoSR
nodes.summary: Hugging Face checkpoint (model.ckpt) plus config. Product Python loads it via TSR.from_pretrained. Swift never downloads it; it loads the remapped safetensors.

nodes.name: ml-explore/mlx-swift
nodes.summary: Swift MLX and MLXNN, from 0.29.1. All three Swift packages depend on it. Metal kernels for marching cubes ship inside ShapERuntime, not inside mlx-swift.

nodes.name: mlx
nodes.summary: Python MLX (mlx.core, mlx.nn). The reference implementation of Shap-E math. pyproject declares mlx-lm, which is how MLX arrives in the environment.

nodes.name: torch
nodes.summary: Used by upstream Shap-E, upstream TripoSR, export scripts, and L0 parity. The Swift inference path does not import it.

nodes.name: mlx_shap_e
nodes.summary: Python package installed from shap_e/src (see pyproject.toml). Holds the MLX models, the runtime bundle contract, and the text-to-mesh runtime. CLI lives beside it in shap_e/src/cli and is run as python -m from that directory.

nodes.name: ShapERuntime
nodes.summary: Swift package. Products: library ShapERuntime, executable ShapECLI. Platforms: macOS 14, iOS 17, visionOS 1. Depends only on mlx-swift. Owns MarchingCubes.metal.

nodes.name: TripoSR
nodes.summary: Consumer-facing Swift package. Same products as the standalone package (TripoSRRuntime, TripoSRCLI) but sources stay under TripoSR/swift so RuntimeWrapper can depend on ../TripoSR without a path named swift colliding.

nodes.name: TripoSRRuntime standalone
nodes.summary: Standalone Swift package for building TripoSRCLI with xcodebuild from TripoSR/swift. Same sources as the root package. Does not depend on ShapERuntime.

nodes.name: RuntimeWrapper
nodes.summary: Library only. Depends on ShapERuntime (path ../shap_e/swift), TripoSRRuntime (path ../TripoSR), and mlx-swift. The TripoSR path is a git submodule; swift build fails until git submodule update --init.

nodes.name: shap_e_model_cache
nodes.summary: OpenAI torch checkpoints and configs: text_cond.pt, image_cond.pt, vector_decoder.pt, ViT-L-14.pt, plus yaml configs. A second copy exists at shap_e/shap_e_model_cache. Export scripts read this. Inference runtimes do not.

nodes.name: runtime_bundle
nodes.summary: Versioned tensor bundle (artifact_version 1) shared by Python MLX and Swift. Families: clip_text, clip_vision, text300m, image300m, diffusion, decoder_params, renderer. Each family is a manifest entry plus raw C-order .bin blobs. The full audited bundle has 1,088 float32 tensors; tensor files total 5,141,395,248 bytes. Gitignored. manifest.json is the contract; canonical schema and layout are docs/FILE-STRUCTURE.md.

nodes.name: runtime_bundle_stub
nodes.summary: Tiny checked-in bundle with the same family layout and random or truncated weights. ShapERuntimeTests load this instead of the full bundle.

nodes.name: runtime_bundle_v1
nodes.summary: Earlier exported bundle: clip_text, text300m, diffusion, decoder_params, renderer. No clip_vision or image300m.

nodes.name: CLIP BPE vocab
nodes.summary: bpe_simple_vocab_16e6.txt.gz. Not a runtime-bundle tensor family or manifest entry. Local exports keep it outside runtime_bundle; the Hugging Face distribution places it beside manifest.json. Swift ShapERuntime init takes it as a separate URL. Python ClipSimpleTokenizer resolves a default path.

nodes.name: signalNotNoise/shap-e-mlx
nodes.summary: Public Hugging Face distribution of the full format-v1 Shap-E runtime bundle at audited revision d71f70a09b9c03535188d006a719edda5c19a6eb. 1,104 files and 5,143,254,750 bytes: 1,088 tensors, manifest, separate BPE file, provenance, checksums, upstream licenses, validation summaries, and re-export driver.

nodes.name: TripoSR model.ckpt
nodes.summary: Upstream PyTorch checkpoint from Hugging Face. Used by run.py, gradio_app.py, and the parity dump. Not loaded by Swift.

nodes.name: triposr_mlx.safetensors
nodes.summary: Intermediate pack of the HF checkpoint. Gitignored. Input to the key remapper. Not loaded by Swift.

nodes.name: triposr_swift_ready.safetensors
nodes.summary: Only weight file TripoSRModel.loadWeights accepts. Keys and layouts already match the Swift modules.

nodes.name: CLIP tokenize
nodes.summary: Prompt string to token ids, context length 77, CLIP BPE.

nodes.name: CLIP text embed
nodes.summary: Token ids through the ViT-L/14 text tower (width 768, 12 heads, 12 layers) to a conditioning embedding. Swift also embeds the empty prompt for classifier-free guidance.

nodes.name: CLIP image embed
nodes.summary: CGImage through CLIP Resize(224)+CenterCrop(224), then the vision tower. Swift only. Loaded on the first image generate, because clip_vision plus image300m is about 2.3 GB.

nodes.name: Text300M forward
nodes.summary: Diffusion transformer conditioned on text embeddings and a timestep. Predicts epsilon and learned variance.

nodes.name: Image300M forward
nodes.summary: Same diffusion-transformer role, conditioned on CLIP image embeddings. Swift only.

nodes.name: Karras Heun sample
nodes.summary: Sigma schedule, Gaussian-to-Karras denoiser, Heun ODE loop, optional CFG, channel unscale. Output is the latent x plus pred_xstart and sigmas.

nodes.name: Latent to NeRSTF params
nodes.summary: Unwarp the latent (identity or tan2), project with per-parameter einsum weights, layer-norm, add bias, reshape to renderer parameter tensors.

nodes.name: STF / NeRSTF field
nodes.summary: Query the implicit field on a grid. SDF plus texture channels. Chunked so high-resolution extracts stay inside GPU memory.

nodes.name: Marching cubes
nodes.summary: SDF grid to verts, faces, and vertex colors. CPU Swift implementation or the Metal kernel. Python MLX has its own marching_cubes. Partial previews during sampling always use the CPU path.

nodes.name: DINOv2 image tokens
nodes.summary: ViT-B/16, embed 768, depth 12, 12 heads. Checkpoint positional embeddings are 14x14 plus CLS for 224 input. Runtime images are 512 and the positional embedding is interpolated. ImageNet mean and std are applied unless the caller already normalized.

nodes.name: Triplane token sequence
nodes.summary: Learnable 1D tokens, plane size 32, 1024 channels. Detokenize returns three planes.

nodes.name: LRM transformer
nodes.summary: Transformer1D, 16 layers, 16 heads, head dim 64, cross-attention dim 768 against the DINO tokens.

nodes.name: Triplane upsample
nodes.summary: 1024 channels to 40, spatial size doubled.

nodes.name: NeRF query
nodes.summary: NeRFMLP (120 in, 64 wide, 9 hidden layers) sampled through the triplane renderer. Returns density and color. This is the end of TripoSRRuntime.

nodes.name: TripoSR mesh extract
nodes.summary: RuntimeWrapper samples a density grid (default 256) in batches (default 8192), thresholds at 25, then calls Shap-E MarchingCubes or MetalMarchingCubes. Input images are resized to 512 and composited on gray (128).

nodes.name: MLXShapERuntime
nodes.summary: Production Python runtime. Loads clip_text, text300m, diffusion, decoder_params, and renderer from the bundle. No image path. decode_latent_to_mesh_mx requires the batch to contain exactly one mesh.

nodes.name: runtime types
nodes.summary: Shared result structs. Swift RuntimeCoreTypes.swift mirrors them.

nodes.name: RuntimeDiffusionConfig
nodes.summary: Schedule tensors and metadata loaded from the diffusion family: betas, alphas, posterior coefficients, channel scale and bias.

nodes.name: RuntimeArtifactBundle
nodes.summary: Reads manifest.json and raw float blobs. Python loader does not expose clip_vision or image300m even though the exporter writes them.

nodes.name: runtime manifest
nodes.summary: On-disk contract: artifact_version, per-family version, metadata, and tensor entries with dtype, shape, and relative path.

nodes.name: runtime artifact exports
nodes.summary: Offline only. Loads torch checkpoints from the cache and writes every runtime_bundle family. Not on the inference path.

nodes.name: Text300MTransformer
nodes.summary: MLX diffusion transformer. Swift folded timestep embedding into Text300MTransformer and does not have a separate WrappedText300M type.

nodes.name: Text300MArtifact
nodes.summary: Weight container and tree conversion for the text transformer. Swift equivalent is Text300MArtifact in RuntimeArtifactTypes.swift plus Text300MArtifact.swift.

nodes.name: MlxClipTextEmbedder
nodes.summary: MLX CLIP text tower. embed_text is the NumPy wrapper around embed_text_mx.

nodes.name: ClipSimpleTokenizer
nodes.summary: CLIP BPE tokenizer: gzip vocab, merges, unicode cleanup, padding and truncation to 77.

nodes.name: diffusion step
nodes.summary: Splits the transformer output into epsilon and variance and computes the learned-range posterior. A NumPy twin of the posterior exists for parity.

nodes.name: Karras sampler
nodes.summary: Production sampler. Also contains NumPy and torch helper branches used by parity, not by MLXShapERuntime (that call sets strict_torch_math False).

nodes.name: MLXChannelsDecoderParams
nodes.summary: Latent unwarp and projection into the renderer parameter dict.

nodes.name: MLXSTFMeshRenderer
nodes.summary: NeRSTF field evaluation and mesh extraction. save_mlx_decoder_artifact and load_mlx_decoder_artifact are the older single-file artifact path, distinct from the runtime bundle.

nodes.name: marching_cubes
nodes.summary: MLX marching cubes with the standard edge table. Compared to torch in tests/test_marching_cubes.py.

nodes.name: ShapETransformer structural port
nodes.summary: Earlier structural MLX sketch of the encoder and renderer modules. The production runtime does not call it. cli/inspect/inspect_model.py imports a name (mlx_shape_data_structures) that is not this module.

nodes.name: map_text300m_weights
nodes.summary: Torch state-dict key remap into the MLX Text300M tree. Used by L0 checks and by the text300m exporter.

nodes.name: runtime golden
nodes.summary: Builds and compares the L1 summary JSON (token ids, embedding stats, sampler heads, mesh counts).

nodes.name: parity tensor dump
nodes.summary: Runs one MLX case and writes python_*.npy for the L2 Swift compare.

nodes.name: cache recovery
nodes.summary: Retries a torch download when the local shap-e cache file is corrupt. Used by exporters.

nodes.name: ShapERuntime
nodes.summary: Swift end-to-end runtime. Init loads text bundle families only. ensureImagePipeline loads clip_vision and image300m on first image call. generate(prompt:) with no batchSize returns one ShapEMeshResult and defaults seed to 0. generate(prompt:batchSize:) and generate(image:) return [ShapEMeshResult]; image batch defaults to 1 and seed to 0.

nodes.name: RuntimeCoreTypes
nodes.summary: Swift mirror of the Python runtime result types. MeshResult is what RuntimeWrapper re-wraps.

nodes.name: RuntimeArtifactTypes
nodes.summary: Loaded artifact structs. ClipTextArtifact lives in Models/embeddings/ClipTextArtifact.swift instead of this file.

nodes.name: RuntimeArtifactBundle
nodes.summary: Swift reader for the same manifest and .bin layout. Loads every family, including clip_vision and image300m.

nodes.name: RuntimeManifest
nodes.summary: Codable manifest models.

nodes.name: TensorBlobLoader
nodes.summary: Reads a raw blob and checks dtype and shape against the manifest entry.

nodes.name: ClipSimpleTokenizer
nodes.summary: Swift CLIP BPE tokenizer. Requires an explicit vocabulary URL.

nodes.name: ClipTextEmbedder
nodes.summary: Swift CLIP text tower over MLXArray.

nodes.name: ClipImageEmbedder
nodes.summary: Swift CLIP vision tower. Paired with ImageProcessor, which turns a CGImage into the 224 normalized tensor.

nodes.name: ImageProcessor
nodes.summary: CGImage to a 224 CLIP tensor: shorter side scaled to 224, then center crop, then CLIP mean/std. Distinct from TripoSR's 512 preprocess.

nodes.name: Text300MTransformer
nodes.summary: Conforms to DiffusionTransformer so the Karras denoiser can call either text or image transformers.

nodes.name: Image300MTransformer
nodes.summary: Image-conditioned diffusion transformer. Same DiffusionTransformer protocol as Text300M.

nodes.name: DiffusionStep
nodes.summary: split vector, extract-into, and learned-range p_mean_variance.

nodes.name: KarrasSampler
nodes.summary: Production Heun loop. Initial noise and churn noise use a per-call RandomState so overlapping sample() calls do not share the process-wide MLX PRNG. Progress callback can hand back an unscaled latent so ShapERuntime can extract a low-res preview mesh.

nodes.name: DecoderParamsProjector
nodes.summary: bottleneck_to_params port: tan2 or identity unwarp, projection, layer norm, bias, reshape. Init fails unless the parameter list consumes latent_ctx exactly.

nodes.name: STFMeshRenderer
nodes.summary: NeRSTF positional encoding, dynamic and static MLP layers, chunked field sampling, then marching cubes. Query chunks default to 65536 at the runtime API. Vertex evaluation inside the renderer is chunked (4096) to avoid GPU faults.

nodes.name: MarchingCubes
nodes.summary: CPU marching cubes. Also used for sampling previews and as the TripoSR mesh backend when Metal is off.

nodes.name: MetalMarchingCubes
nodes.summary: GPU marching cubes. Kernel source is MarchingCubes.metal, compiled as a package resource. Tables live in MCTable.swift.

nodes.name: MeshExport
nodes.summary: OBJ export with vertex colors (v x y z r g b). MeshTopology.swift reports connectivity stats.

nodes.name: ShapECLI
nodes.summary: Executable. Generation CLI and the --parity dump used by L2. The root README still mentions an older tool name, something, under swift/something.

nodes.name: TSR
nodes.summary: Upstream system module. from_pretrained loads config plus model.ckpt. Wires image tokenizer, triplane tokenizer, backbone, post processor, decoder, and renderer. Product CLIs and the parity dump both construct this. They do not call each other.

nodes.name: DINOSingleImageTokenizer
nodes.summary: PyTorch DINO image tokenizer.

nodes.name: Triplane1DTokenizer
nodes.summary: PyTorch learnable triplane tokens and detokenize.

nodes.name: Transformer1D
nodes.summary: LRM backbone. Attention and BasicTransformerBlock live in the sibling files.

nodes.name: NeRFMLP and TriplaneNeRFRenderer
nodes.summary: Density and color query. TriplaneUpsampleNetwork and NeRFMLP are in network_utils.py.

nodes.name: MarchingCubeHelper
nodes.summary: Upstream mesh extract via torchmcubes. Used by run.py. Not used by the Swift runtime or by RuntimeWrapper.

nodes.name: bake_texture
nodes.summary: Optional texture atlas baking for the Python product CLI. No Swift port.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Official image-to-mesh CLI. Optional rembg and baked textures. Does not call Swift.

nodes.name: gradio_app.py
nodes.summary: Local Gradio UI over the same TSR stack. Not part of parity.

nodes.name: export_tripo_weights
nodes.summary: Downloads the HF checkpoint and packs triposr_mlx.safetensors.

nodes.name: convert_weights_to_mlx
nodes.summary: Remaps keys and layouts to triposr_swift_ready.safetensors.

nodes.name: TripoSRModel
nodes.summary: Swift module graph: DINOv2Model, Triplane1DTokenizer, LRMTransformer1D, TriplaneUpsampleNetwork, NeRFMLP, TripoSRRenderer. TripoSRRuntime.swift in the same folder is only a file header. There is no marching cubes here.

nodes.name: DINOv2Model
nodes.summary: Patch embed, attention, MLP, and layer stack. Files: DINOv2PatchEmbed, DINOv2Attention, DINOv2MLP, DINOv2Layer.

nodes.name: LRMTransformer1D
nodes.summary: Cross-attention backbone. Pieces: LRMAttention, LRMBasicTransformerBlock, LRMFeedForward.

nodes.name: Triplane1DTokenizer
nodes.summary: Learnable tokens plus detokenize. Upsample is TriplaneUpsampleNetwork.swift.

nodes.name: NeRFMLP
nodes.summary: Decoder MLP. Queried by TripoSRRenderer.queryTriplane.

nodes.name: TripoSRRenderer
nodes.summary: Triplane sample and NeRF query. Radius 0.87. Does not extract a mesh.

nodes.name: TripoSRCLI
nodes.summary: Executable. --parity writes swift_*.npy from the shared parity inputs and the swift-ready weights. Build with xcodebuild so the MLX metallib is found.

nodes.name: ThreeDGenerationRuntime
nodes.summary: Selects a backend at init. Image generate works for both. Prompt generate throws promptUnsupported unless the backend is Shap-E. Defaults: Shap-E grid 128 and query batch 65536, TripoSR grid 256 and query batch 8192.

nodes.name: TripoSRMeshRuntime
nodes.summary: The only Swift path that turns TripoSR density into a mesh. Imports both TripoSRRuntime and ShapERuntime. Owns 512 gray-background preprocess.

nodes.name: ThreeDMeshResult
nodes.summary: Model-neutral mesh. Backed by ShapERuntime.MeshResult so both backends share one result type.

nodes.name: run_text300m_mlx_pipeline
nodes.summary: Python product CLI. Prompt to latent to mesh, writes obj, ply, npz, and metadata. Decodes latent[0] even though the runtime accepts a batch. Run from shap_e/src as python -m cli.run.run_text300m_mlx_pipeline.

nodes.name: sample_text300m_karras_mlx
nodes.summary: Sampling-only CLI. Stops at the latent.

nodes.name: decode_text300m_latent_to_mesh
nodes.summary: Latent npz to mesh. Has both the torch decoder path and the MLX renderer path.

nodes.name: generate_text300m_reference_mesh
nodes.summary: Torch Shap-E reference mesh. Uses openai/shap-e sampling, then the local decode helper.

nodes.name: cli.export
nodes.summary: Per-family exporters: clip text, text300m, diffusion, decoder. The all-family writer is prepare_runtime_artifacts in offline_tools.

nodes.name: run_mesh_ab.sh
nodes.summary: CPU versus Metal marching-cubes A/B for holey Vision meshes. Writes shap_e/mesh_ab_smoke. Documented in shap_e/MESH_AB.md.

nodes.name: Coding standards
nodes.summary: Deterministic changed-file gate for docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md. Enforces one primary type in new production files, anti-growth in existing files, documentation on newly added public Swift/Python declarations, secret/personal-path scans, oversized files, and Markdown links. It intentionally has no file line-count rule. Verification is local Mac/Xcode only because the project targets macOS, iOS, and visionOS with MLX/Metal and local artifacts. --all reports the legacy baseline as warnings.

nodes.name: L0 Torch vs Python MLX
nodes.summary: Report-only metrics. Gate to re-run when re-exporting weights. Swift is not involved. Scripts: check_text300m_parity, check_mlx_diffusion_step_parity, check_mlx_karras_loop_parity, check_mlx_karras_model_output_parity, check_mlx_decoder_params_parity, check_mlx_mesh_renderer_parity.

nodes.name: L1 MLX golden
nodes.summary: Summary JSON for prompt 'a red chair', seed 7, steps 2, sigma 0.001 to 160, grid 16. Asserted by check_mlx_runtime_golden and, when MLX_SHAP_E_RUN_GOLDENS=1, tests/test_runtime_golden.py.

nodes.name: L2 Python MLX vs Swift
nodes.summary: dump_mlx_swift_parity writes python_*.npy and case.json, ShapECLI --parity writes swift_*.npy, compare_mlx_swift_parity asserts. Tokens, CLIP, and sigmas are exact. Latent, pred_xstart, decoder params, and SDF need correlation at least 0.999. CPU mesh verts are correlated and faces are exact. Metal mesh check is counts plus bounding box. Dumps live in shap_e/parity.

nodes.name: TripoSR Python vs Swift
nodes.summary: dump_python_parity.py uses TSR directly (not run.py), TripoSRCLI --parity, compare_parity.py. Scores correlation and mean abs on tokens, triplanes, density, and color. High correlation, not bit-exact. Does not compare meshes. Default image is examples/chair.png.

nodes.name: Python tests
nodes.summary: test_check_standards.py, test_clip_text_embedder.py, test_download_shap_e_bundle.py, test_marching_cubes.py, test_mesh_batch_decode.py, test_runtime_golden.py, test_swift_test_runner.py.

nodes.name: ShapERuntimeTests
nodes.summary: Tokenizer, CLIP text embedder, decoder projector, diffusion step, text300m artifact and transformer, runtime bundle loading. Uses the stub bundle.

nodes.name: TripoSRRuntimeTests
nodes.summary: Swift unit tests for the TripoSR package.

nodes.name: RuntimeWrapperTests
nodes.summary: Facade tests. Depends on RuntimeWrapper and MLX.

nodes.name: P2 batch decode ambiguity
nodes.summary: Open. MLXShapERuntime accepts a batch latent, and decode_latent_to_mesh_mx errors unless the batch has one mesh. The pipeline CLI explicitly decodes latent_result.latent[0].

nodes.name: Stale package lazy imports
nodes.summary: The package __getattr__ map points at mlx_shap_e.diffusion.* and mlx_shap_e.embeddings.*, which are not packages. The real modules are under mlx_shap_e.models. runtime_core and runtime_artifacts lazy maps are correct. Import submodules directly.

nodes.name: TripoSR docs lag the wrapper
nodes.summary: TripoSR/README.md and SCRIPTS.md say a Swift mesh is not available and that meshing stays in run.py. That is true of TripoSRRuntime. RuntimeWrapper.TripoSRMeshRuntime now extracts a mesh with Shap-E marching cubes. Texture baking and rembg are still Python-only.

nodes.name: Canonical file and release documentation
nodes.summary: docs/FILE-STRUCTURE.md is the canonical tracked/ignored path map and runtime-bundle format contract. docs/RELEASE-STATUS.md records pinned GitHub/Hugging Face revisions, validation evidence and limits, and publication gates. docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md is the detailed coding policy enforced locally by scripts/check_standards.py, scripts/verify.sh, and hooks. Update affected documents together when layout, revisions, bundle counts, standards, or validation scope changes.

nodes.name: update_graph.py
nodes.summary: Rebuilds graph.json from curated.json and a source scan. Agents run it before they finish a change. The pre-commit hook runs it on every commit.

nodes.name: pre-commit knowledge graph hook
nodes.summary: Runs update_graph.py and stages graph.json and the knowledge-graph README on every commit. Active when core.hooksPath is .githooks.

nodes.name: Knowledge graph refresh
nodes.summary: Every agent is required to refresh the graph before finishing a change. The hook repeats that refresh at commit time, so a tool that skips the instruction still cannot commit a stale graph.json.

edges.note: Same sources. Root package exists so consumers are not pointed at a directory named swift.

Documents the format-v1 schema and local bundle layout.
